<function name="SetCollisionBoundsWS" parent="Entity" type="classfunc">
	<description>
A convenience function that sets the collision bounds for the entity in world space coordinates by transforming given vectors to entity's local space and passing them to <page>Entity:SetCollisionBounds</page>
	</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="vec1" type="Vector">The first vector of the bounds.</arg>
		<arg name="vec2" type="Vector">The second vector of the bounds.</arg>
	</args>
</function>
